title: Geologic Map of the Campobello Quadrangle, Greenville and Spartanburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Garihan, J.M., Wickard, A.K., Chan Soo, R, and Ranson, W.A., 2011, Geologic Map of the Campobello Quadrangle, Greenville and Spartanburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-51, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet (Inner Piedmont) with explanation, major findings, photo captions and cross sections; map face is noise. Symbols: Qal, PMa(s), TF and TFhaf placed after descriptions (inferred); HSmg from OCR '“HSmg_'; others illegible. OCR fold-phase subscripts ('F,', 'F;', 'F>', 'F)', 'Fy', 'F7') read as F1/F2 where the text makes it clear, flagged and sent to review; others left as printed in quotes. Faults Hooker Ridge, Little Mtn. and Skyland are named only in the explanation and are not recorded (legend rule); fold and foliation symbols likewise. Skipped references: Barker 1998 (textbook) and Hatcher 2002 (North Carolina field guide).
SUBSURFACE: sections A-A', B-B', C-C', D-D' (page 1) are drawn to sea level with no vertical exaggeration, axes about +1500 to -1500 feet (+450 to -450 meters); unit labels along them are mostly illegible ('TF', 'F2 synform'), so no units or elevations are recorded. Base map 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 6 meters.
